device.soc: ALi M3606 / M3601E (the maincode chunk's version "M3601 Demo" with bootloader "DVBS2---0.1.0")
device.family: M3602 (chips/m3602.py: the M36xx family with chip ID 0x3602)

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 ("DVBS2---0.1.0" 2010-03-11), upgcode 0x01FE00 (upg 1.0.0), maincode 0x020000 (M3601 Demo, 13-byte XOR + LZMA 0x1CDBA4 bytes -> 6.80 MB), seecode 0x20C000 (MSEE Demo, 13-byte XOR + LZMA 0x0A27DD bytes -> 2.00 MB), BOOTLOG 0x2D0000 (1.0.0), Radioback 0x2E0000 (1.0.0), defaultdb 0x2F0000 (1.1.0), userdb 0x30FF80 (1.0.0, 0x0E0070 bytes)

source.note: Unpacked from SKYBOX_A3_A4_M5_3606HD_CMT_14012005F1.rar in the mirror's Openbox/Skybox A3-A4-M5 folder.

simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with chip ID 0x3602 (run_dump_skybox_a3_app_starts.py): the "DVBS2---0.1.0" bootloader copies its MIPS16e payload into RAM at 0x81E80000, unscrambles the 13-byte rolling-XOR-obfuscated seecode and maincode chunks in 64 KB blocks and decompresses them via LzmaDec_DecodeToBuf (0x81E88274) to 0xA1A00200 (2.00 MB) and 0x80000200 (6.80 MB), parks the SEE at 0xA1E92F14 (which copies seecode to 0xA6000200), and jumps to 0x80000200.  The application starts the SEE's program at 0xA6000200 on the second core, exchanges remote calls with the SEE core, and drives the open-drain 3-wire PT6315 / uPD16315 24-byte VFD front panel (display mode 0x04, 3 RAM bytes per grid) on CLK = GPIO 62, DIO = GPIO 63, STB = GPIO 64 through "LOAD" and the "LOO1".."LO93" boot progress counter.

desc: The 14012005F1 CMT firmware update of the Skybox A3 / A4 / M5 HD satellite receivers (board "3606HD_CMT", 2014-01-20), built on the dual-CPU ALi M3606 / M3602 platform.

The "DVBS2---0.1.0" bootloader unscrambles the 13-byte rolling-XOR-obfuscated `seecode` and `maincode` chunks in 64 KB windows and unpacks them via LZMA SDK 9.x `LzmaDec_DecodeToBuf` before starting both cores and animating `LOAD` -> `LOO1`..`LO93` on a 24-byte PT6315 / uPD16315 3-wire VFD front panel.
